To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the mgtCBR leader mRNA from Salmonella contains two tandem attenuators, one that is controlled by the level of ATP and the other by the availability of proline.
the mgtC, mgtB and mgtR genes are controlled by two attenuators, each responding to a different signal.

two short ORFs in the leader mRNA of the mgtCBR Salmonella operon control transcription of the operon coding region by an independent and additive response to changes in the levels of ATP and proline.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how the mgtCBR mRNA is regulated by different signals in order to control expression of the MgtC, MgtB and MgtR proteins.
the identification of the mgtCBR regulatory elements, and the characterization of the mechanisms controlling the expression of the mgtB and mgtC virulence genes.
the identification and characterization of a novel mechanism for the control of virulence gene expression in a human pathogen.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the mgtCBR leader transcript is a two‐attenuator mRNA that is regulated by ATP and proline.
the two tandem attenuators in the mgtCBR leader mRNA are controlled independently by different signals.
the mgtCBR leader mRNA has tandem attenuators that respond to different signals.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
mgtCBR expression is controlled by two tandem attenuators, each sensing a specific signal, and that the signals act independently in a synergistic manner.
the mgtC‐mgtB operon is controlled by two tandem attenuators that respond to different environmental conditions.
the mgtCBR mRNA is an attenuator‐like structure that responds to the availability of ATP, proline and Mg2+.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the mgtCBR leader mRNA is a sensor that monitors the availability of two essential nutrients (proline and ATP) and responds by increasing the expression of two virulence proteins (MgtC and MgtB).
the mgtCBR leader mRNA is a versatile device for the control of virulence gene expression.
the mgtCBR leader mRNA is an important determinant of Salmonella virulence.
